name: Union Commonwealth University
oos_note: private single rate = in-state. Union Commonwealth University (Barbourville, KY) is a private/independent university; its tuition page (unionky.edu/tuition) lists a single tuition ($29,600) + comprehensive fee ($2,400) applying to all students with no separate non-resident rate. Set equal to known in-state tuition & fees of $32,110.
